items.exampleEn: This phone plan includes unlimited data.
items.exampleZh: 這個手機方案包含無限上網。

items.exampleEn: The landlord made a deduction from my deposit for the broken window.
items.exampleZh: 房東因為窗戶破了，從我的押金裡扣了一筆錢。

items.exampleEn: The payment failed because of insufficient funds.
items.exampleZh: 因為餘額不足，付款失敗了。

items.exampleEn: If you subtract ten from fifty, you get forty.
The truck can carry five tons of sand.
items.exampleZh: 這台卡車能載五噸沙子。

items.exampleEn: About eight billion people live in the world today.
items.exampleZh: 現在世界上大約有八十億人。

items.exampleEn: A large percentage of our customers are students.
items.exampleZh: 我們有很大比例的顧客是學生。

items.exampleEn: The overall cost of the project was lower than planned.
items.exampleZh: 這個專案的整體成本比計畫的低。

items.sentenceEn: Overall, our sales this year were better than last year.
items.sentenceZh: 整體來說，我們今年的銷售比去年好。

items.audioEn: We can't start the project yet because we have insufficient staff.
items.audioZh: 人手不足，所以我們還不能開始這個專案。
items.questionZh: 為什麼還不能開始這個專案？

items.sentenceEn: Members get unlimited use of the gym and the pool.
items.sentenceZh: 會員可以無限次使用健身房和游泳池。

items.sentenceEn: Only a small percentage of the staff work from home.
items.sentenceZh: 只有一小部分員工在家工作。

items.stemEn: After the tax ____, my monthly salary is about forty thousand dollars.
items.stemZh: 扣掉稅之後，我的月薪大約是四萬元。

items.stemEn: To find the profit, ____ the costs from the total sales.
items.stemZh: 要算出利潤，就把總銷售額減去成本。

items.passageEn: Last year, our company sold more than three billion dollars' worth of steel, which is about two million tons. Overall, it was a satisfactory year. Sales grew by eight percent, and the percentage of products sold overseas rose to forty percent. However, not everything went well. One factory had insufficient workers in the summer, so we lost some orders. When you subtract the cost of new machines, profits were only a little higher than the year before. The company also announced a new benefit: staff will get unlimited coffee, and the cost is small, just a monthly deduction of fifty dollars from each salary.
items.passageZh: 去年，我們公司賣出超過三十億美元的鋼材，大約兩百萬噸。整體來說，這是令人滿意的一年。銷售成長了百分之八，外銷產品的比例也提高到百分之四十。不過，並非一切順利。有一家工廠夏天工人不足，所以我們失去了一些訂單。扣掉新機器的成本後，利潤只比前一年高一點。公司也宣佈了一項新福利：員工可以無限暢飲咖啡，費用不高，每人每月薪水只扣五十美元。

questions.questionZh: 去年的銷售成長了多少？
有一家工廠夏天發生了什麼問題？
options: 機器壞了，停工兩個星期

items.promptZh: 這個房間的光線不足，沒辦法看書。
referenceEn: The light in this room is insufficient for reading.
There is insufficient light in this room to read.
rubricZh: insufficient 表示「不足的」，放在名詞前或 be 動詞後（例如 insufficient light、is insufficient）
「沒辦法看書」可寫 for reading、to read 等；寫 not enough light 意思也對

items.instructionZh: 用 percentage 造一個句子，說說你的收入、時間或生活中某部分的比例。
referenceEn: I save a small percentage of my salary every month.
A large percentage of my free time is spent reading.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 percentage（例如 a large／small percentage of… 等）
句子要說到你自己的生活
